wiki.title: Robbie
wiki.text:
Robbie is a robgoblin NPC that can be found at Camp Robbie, located in the Greenwood Forest. Robbie, along with Chatty, are the official mascots of Free Realms.

Robbie is also an NPC boss in Bigfoot's Lair, he used to wear the Bigfoot costume which come to attack the player in the battle.
